Carries the Bugsink bring-up's operator tooling at the repo root (the `just provision-bugsink` recipe family, `scripts/provision_bugsink_config.py`, the root pyproject/lock updates) via a merge of `mngr/env-tier-sentry`, ahead of that branch landing on main. Additionally updates `specs/minds-bugsink-error-tracking.md` with the reporting policy this branch implements: error-level events for unexpected failures, warning-level events for tolerated ones, and OpenObserve `metric` log lines for expected routine anomalies.
